Thirteen comments

Sunday’s Well

This is the second waltz played by Caitlín Nic Gabhann in her first recording : Caitlín.
She says : “I wrote this tune while studying in Cork. Sunday’s Well is the area in Cork city where the music building university College Cork is located.”

↳ Posted by Pierre LAÏLY on November 8th, 2013.

I love this tune.

↳ Posted by Banjo Joe on January 8th, 2014.

Re: Sunday’s Well

Not familiar with this waltz, but lived on Sundays Well while attending the Cork School of Music. I believe the UCC music building is a repurposed church that used to have a statue of a very severe looking clergy outside… it’s probably gone now that UCC have taken possession of the building.
